headword: {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A business or person that sells goods directly to consumers, as opposed to wholesalers who sell to other businesses.

examples.japanese: {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卸|おろ}す→卸す：02463_orosu⟧。
⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大型店|おおがたてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}されている→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: Local retailers are being squeezed by large stores.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット{通販|つうはん}→ネット通販：22847_nettotsuuhan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The spread of online shopping has drastically changed the business environment for retailers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧ (retail) + ⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (business operator). Refers to businesses that sell products directly to end consumers. Can refer to both individual shop owners and larger retail companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{卸|おろ}す→卸す：02463_orosu⟧: to wholesale to retailers
- {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: retail business management
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}: major retailers
- {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧: retailers and consumers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卸売業者|おろしうりぎょうしゃ}: wholesaler — sells to businesses rather than consumers
- ⟦{販売店|はんばいてん}→販売店：20898_hanbaiten⟧: retail outlet / dealer — refers to the store itself rather than the business entity
- ⟦{小売店|こうりてん}→小売店：20689_kouriten⟧: retail shop — focuses on the physical store rather than the business operator
